profile.name: Chase
profile.title: Type. 0 Chase
profile.like: Scarlet, Demia, Clause, and friends call him by this name
profile.dislike: Memory from the past, test subject number.
profile.story:
A man who has lost his memory. Test subject Type. 0 that was born as a part of the human enhancement experiment of the empire. 
As the first type of the Project Evil Knights that were only made to kill, Chase was brought through a secretive contract with the empire to assassinate the sole successor to its throne, Scarlet.
However, he went berserk for unknown reasons during a fight against Clause and Demia who were guarding Scarlet, and he abandoned his mission and left. He failed to kill Scarlet and disappeared, so the nobles who had commissioned the assassination found themselves in trouble. In the end, they hired another assassination group, the Laughing Mask, to have him killed. However, Scarlet already gave him a name, Chase, and let him stay by her side.

1.name: I'll Break You!
1.description:
Prevents the target from receiving positive effects for 4 seconds, and attacks to inflict ??? P.DMG and knocks the target back. 
Inflicts ??? P.DMG after 1 second to enemies around the target and stuns them for 4 seconds.

2.name: Remove Limit
2.description: Upon activation, [Remove Limit] takes effect. When activated, consumes 10% of current HP to remove all negative effects from self and deal ??? P.DMG to nearby enemies in range. While [Remove Limit] is activated, consumes 1.5% of current HP every 1 sec, gains immunity to CC, increases Crit DMG by 50% and ATK Spd by 500, and enhances normal attacks. The HP consumption, Crit DMG and ATK Spd Boost grow stronger over time. This effect is irremovable, and is automatically deactivated when HP falls under 25% or below.

3.name: Burn, Spear of Fury
3.description: Charges at an enemy, dealing ??? P.DMG and knocking it down. Afterward, explodes the ground around self to attack 4 times, dealing a total of ??? P.DMG and inflicting Stun for 5 sec. Each hit recovers HP equal to 3% of Chase's Max HP + 25% of DMG.

4.name: Remember This in Hell
4.description: Chase is not affected by Lifesteal stats. Instead, increases self's Max HP by 20%, Crit Chance by 100, CC ACC by 100, and ACC by 100. Whenever HP drops by 1%, increases Crit DMG by 1% and ATK Spd by 4. Upon taking a fatal DMG, resurrects for 5 sec, increasing Crit DMG by 40%, ATK Spd by 400, and gaining immunity to CC for the duration. The resurrection effect can be activated only once in battle, and resurrected Chase cannot use skills.

uw.name: Blood Lancer Monolith
uw.description: Increases own Crit DMG by 20%. Upon auto attack, deals P.DMG equal to 30% of ATK with [Flame of Monolith] and recovers HP equal to 20% of DMG dealt. When [Remove Limit] is active, the effect of [Flame of Monolith] is doubled.
uw.story:
A weapon for Enhanced Human Type. 0 that was made after thousands of attempts in one of the laboratories of the empire. 
Enhanced Human Type. 0 destroyed everything as soon as he woke up from the laboratory in order to find a weapon that could withstand his power.
In the end, he tore out the horn of the monster Cannibal, which was known to have swallowed Arrogance out of the 7 sins. 
This horn went through the hands of the greatest blacksmiths of the empire and became the Blood Lancer Monolith.
The flame of sin is burning inside the weapon, and whatever it pierces cannot be healed. 
The feeling of striking with this weapon is pleasurable enough to make him forget about the lingering attachment to his lost memory.

2.name: Handkerchief of Loyalty
2.description: [Remove Limit] Deals P.DMG equal to 40% of ATK to nearby enemies every sec and increases Heal Rate by 30% for the duration of Skill.
2.story:
An item given to Chase by Scarlet. She gave it to him because she felt sorry for him for not having a name.
Chase's name is embroidered in one corner of the handkerchief. 
It doesn't really match his look, but he carries it all the time. 
Chase lost his memory and could only figure out who he was by the test subject code marked on his waist. The moment when someone called him by a name was when he finally found a goal in life. 
He decided to use his overflowing power to protect those who made him feel alive.

3.name: Unrelenting Pauldron
3.description: [Burn, Spear of Fury] Reduces Mana Cost by 1 and increases DMG by 20%.
3.story:
Pauldron that Chase wears on one shoulder. It is made up of special ores that are hard to find in the Orbis Continent. 
It's light but extremely sturdy and unbreakable. 
An item that Demia managed to get for Chase, since Scarlet was fond of him.
Demia didn't show it much, but she was intrigued by how Chase normally seemed so naive, and yet was so enthusiastic when it came to sparring. 
Demia watched him for a few days, and one day, patting his shoulder, she nonchalantly gave Chase the pauldron. She told him that fighting was important, but it was also important to take care of his own body.

4.name: Biometric Sensor - Type. 0
4.description: [Remember This in Hell] Increases DMG dealt to Non-Hero targets by {0}% and reduces DMG taken by 20%.
4.story:
A life form sensor that was installed on Chase's waist.
It looks like a small, oval capsule, and is designed to be inserted in the bodies of test subjects.
Stamped on the capsule is the test subject code name, 'Type. 0,' and it contains a strange red material that stores information.
This biometric sensor can store various tests and research information and logs the information of the test subject's location.
If someone tries to take it out with force, it will self-detonate and kill the test subject to keep the experiments confidential.
When Chase ripped this out of his waist, he broke it instantly. This small thing had been distorting his soul for too long.
Then, he made a promise himself.
He wanted to make those who drove him to misery tremble in fear, just from hearing his name.

sw.story:
Chase vaguely knew that the voice from nowhere that gave him the feeling of his heart tightening up and his heart rate increasing as if he had done something terribly wrong as well as the feeling of anxiety that crippled him to look only at the floor and nowhere else was guilt and the longing for something, or someone.
Whenever the unknown voice from a mysterious figure started whispering to whomever the message was intended for, Chase would seal his ears with his fingers in the hopes of avoiding it, but the endless whispers slowly chipped away Chase’s sanity. When Chase felt he was about to go completely insane, Cannibal's ego that was sleeping inside Monolith spoke to Chase.
It told Chase to succumb to its flame. Once he gives in, the voices will disappear.
True to Cannibal’s words, Chase could avoid hearing the voices while using Monolith, but he started relying on it more and more.

Upon seeing Chase harnessing the flame that also damages its wielder, Scarlet scolded him heavily, but whenever the battle would take place, Chase, even after saying that he will try not to use Monolith, would mindlessly swing the Flame of Monolith.
Worried that Chase may one day go berserk again, Scarlet requested Annette, the kingdom’s revered technomagi, to investigate Chase and Monolith. Upon investigating, Annette found out that Monolith has become a vessel for the soul of Cannibal, the Beast of Arrogance, and that Cannibal’s Mana was affecting Chase’s sanity.
Annette also told Scarlet that Cannibal has been feeding upon Chase’s hidden anxiety and his longing for the ones he had forgotten, and that if Chase doesn't do something, Cannibal will one day consume Chase who left a scar on it.

Nonetheless, Chase marches on with faith that he will not succumb to the flaming beast, with his comrades from the castle who provide endless support and encouragement.
